backend/main.mo: Main backend canister implementing comment management, AI comment generation, rating images, user profiles, wallet balances, payment records, access control with admin authentication, bulk generation logs, and app event tracking using Motoko maps and lists.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features: comment length dropdown in AiCommentGenerator, enhanced unique comment generation algorithm, list visibility fix in AiCommentTable, and skeleton loader with typing effect animation.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including App.tsx with lazy loading, optimized React Query hooks, admin authentication, tabbed navigation, and various UI components with animations and theme support.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining CSS variables for light and dark themes, including colors for background, foreground, primary, secondary, destructive, borders, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with pre-React error handler to prevent blank pages on fatal errors, browser shim for process.env, and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component with lazy-loaded pages (AdminPanel, UserView, UploadSection, LiveListChecker), tabbed navigation, admin authentication with session storage, theme provider, and memoized event handlers for performance.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Presentational component displaying an access denied message with shield icon and alert for non-admin users attempting to access the Admin Panel.
A dialog component for entering and submitting an access key required for bulk comment generation, with password input, loading state, and keyboard submit support.
frontend/src/components/AdminChatPanel.t: Admin panel component for viewing and replying to user messages, with real-time message display, unread count badge, delete functionality, and auto-scroll to latest messages.
frontend/src/components/AdminDetailsCard: Displays static admin information card showing name (Nishant Chaudhary), contact number, progression status (student), and payment timing details.
frontend/src/components/AdminMusicManage: Admin component for uploading and managing background music files (MP3/WAV), with file validation, preview, upload progress tracking, and music player integration.
frontend/src/components/AdminPinDialog.t: Modal dialog for admin authentication requiring a 4-digit PIN code, with validation, error handling, and animated UI feedback.
frontend/src/components/AdminUserImageTa: Admin interface for bulk uploading user rating images with progress tracking, download functionality, and image removal capabilities per user.
frontend/src/components/AiCommentCounter: Dashboard card component displaying the total count of AI-generated comments with gradient styling and chart icon.
frontend/src/components/AiCommentGenerat: React component for generating AI comments with configurable length, rating, and quantity. Uses predefined word lists and sentence structures to create varied, realistic-looking comments with copy and bulk generation features.
frontend/src/components/AiCommentTable.t: Displays a table of generated AI comments with typing animation effects, individual copy/delete actions, and bulk copy functionality. Includes loading states, confirmation dialogs, and timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedBackgrou: Canvas-based animated background with floating particles and geometric shapes (circles, squares, triangles) that move and rotate. Includes performance optimizations like FPS throttling and visibility detection.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundMusicP: Empty component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/BulkGeneratorKey: Admin interface for managing the bulk comment generator access key. Allows setting, viewing (masked), and resetting the key with confirmation dialogs and status badges.
frontend/src/components/ChatBox.tsx: Placeholder component that returns null, noted as no longer used in admin-only mode.
frontend/src/components/Css3DCube.tsx: Renders a 3D CSS cube animation positioned at the bottom-right corner of the screen as a non-interactive visual element.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary component that catches and displays errors with a user-friendly UI, offering reload and retry options.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying copyright year and attribution link to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking parameters.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with app branding, theme toggle, midnight countdown timer, and admin status badge with logout button when admin is unlocked.
frontend/src/components/Interactive3DCub: A React Three Fiber component that renders an interactive 3D cube with continuous rotation, mouse-based interaction, hover effects, and color transitions between orange and blue.
frontend/src/components/MidnightCountdow: A countdown timer component that displays time remaining until midnight, shows motivational messages on reset, and uses a custom hook for countdown logic.
frontend/src/components/TopDownShooterGa: A canvas-based top-down shooter game with player movement, enemy spawning, projectile shooting, collision detection, score tracking, and high score persistence to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that manages the backend actor instance, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminLiveListQueri: Provides React Query hooks for admin operations on app events including CRUD operations, username management, and local storage caching with a hardcoded admin access code.
frontend/src/hooks/useAiCommentQueries.t: React Query hooks for managing AI-generated comments including creation, retrieval, deletion, and bulk clearing operations with admin access control.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceId.ts: A simple React hook that returns a stable device identifier from localStorage using a memoized utility function.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceScopedGenera: Mutation hook for generating single comments scoped to a device, updating both backend state and localStorage mirror while invalidating related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceScopedUserCo: Provides query hooks to check if a device has generated a comment for a list and to fetch device-scoped comment history, syncing data between backend and localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveListQueries.ts: Exports React Query hooks for fetching app event IDs and checking usernames against app events using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useMidnightCommentLis: Automatically clears comment lists at midnight (00:00-00:59) once per day using localStorage to track last clear date and invalidates related queries.
Provides a countdown timer to midnight with formatted time display and reset detection for UI updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useMusicPlayer.ts: Manages background music playback with volume control, play/pause state, localStorage persistence, and periodic polling for music URL updates from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for CRUD operations on comment lists, messages, ratings, and images with optimized caching strategies and admin access control.
frontend/src/hooks/useTypingEffect.ts: Creates a typing animation effect that progressively displays text character-by-character with configurable speed and initial delay.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, animation keyframes, and 3D cube styling using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/account/ProfilePage.t: Displays user profile information (name, email, mobile, UPI) read from localStorage with styled cards and icons.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLiveListPanel.ts: Admin panel for managing app/event live lists with functionality to create events, add/remove usernames, reset lists, and delete events using React Query mutations and shadcn/ui components.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Main admin dashboard with tabbed interface for managing comment lists, chat, user images, bulk generator keys, live lists, music, and AI comment generation, including data export and clear-all functionality.
frontend/src/pages/auth/SignInPage.tsx: Empty file for sign-in page implementation.
frontend/src/pages/auth/SignUpPage.tsx: Empty file for sign-up page implementation.
frontend/src/pages/LiveListChecker.tsx: Public-facing page that allows users to select an app/event and check if specific usernames exist in that event's list, displaying results in a table.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentsPage: Displays a payment history page with transaction cards showing amount, timestamp, status badges (approved/rejected/pending), and transaction IDs. Currently shows an empty state with mock data structure.
frontend/src/pages/UploadSection.tsx: User interface for uploading rating images with username metadata and generating bulk comments using an access key, with locked list detection and clipboard copy functionality.
frontend/src/pages/UserView.tsx: Customer-facing page with a top-down shooter game and single comment generator that enforces device-scoped one-time generation per list with locked list detection.
frontend/src/pages/wallet/WalletPage.tsx: Renders a wallet balance page displaying the current balance (mock value of 0) in a card with gradient styling and informational text about wallet usage.
frontend/src/utils/adminPinSession.ts: Exports a constant ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE set to '5676' for backend admin operation compatibility.
frontend/src/utils/dataExport.ts: Provides exportAllData function that fetches comments, app events, and messages from the backend actor and exports them as both CSV and JSON files with timestamped filenames.
Manages per-device comment history in localStorage with functions to load, save, update, and clear device-specific history keyed by deviceId and CommentListId.
frontend/src/utils/deviceId.ts: Generates and persists a unique device identifier in localStorage using crypto.randomUUID or fallback random hex generation, independent of authenticated principal.
frontend/src/utils/localStorageCache.ts: Implements a versioned localStorage cache with 5-minute TTL for AppEvent data, providing save, load, and clear functions with automatic expiration handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and functions to clear parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme extensions including color variables, border radius, keyframe animations (pulse-glow, fade-in, slide-in), and animation utilities with dark mode support.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking an AI Comment Generator web application with React/TypeScript frontend, Motoko backend on Internet Computer, featuring dark theme UI, comment length selection, smart generation, 3D CSS cube, and typing animations. Contains architectural notes, existing features with requirement IDs, and implementation history across multiple versions.
